Assertion FAILED: attack_old_keyA_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: attack_old_keyA_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After explicitly re-saving the OAuth source to refresh JWKS, authentik still accepted a JWT signed by the old key (stale trust material / incoherent config update).

Implication: Provider accepted JWT from untrusted Source-B before any explicit trust expansion, violating authorization binding to broker policy.
